entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 270260649602149760: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 15.4752 +/- 0.0345 mas (same row, RUWE 1.12): 64.62 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 12.873, -19.046 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.2775 +/- 0.008 solar radii from Mori et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1696 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..298M/abstract). Mass 0.255 +/- 0.0066 solar masses from Mori et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1696 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..298M/abstract). Temperature 3185 +/- 76 K from Mori et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1696 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,185 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffbe79. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 3,185 K and log g 4.96 (u1 0.155, u2 0.480): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
